what.text: This page follows refugees from Nigeria living in Cameroon, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 127090 Nigerian refugees in Cameroon, 26.6% of all refugees from Nigeria.
The Niger hosts the most Nigerian refugees, followed by Cameroon, Chad and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Nigeria with JAS in 2009 and from 2011 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Nigeria from 2015 to 2025, at war level in most of those years, and over Biafra territory with IPOB from 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 17000 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 131920, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2015 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Cameroon.
These are year-end totals for Cameroon only, reported to UNHCR.
